description: This file defines an abstract class 'ManagedBuffer' which provides an interface for immutable byte data views, with methods for size, conversion to ByteBuffer and InputStream, reference counting, and conversion to Netty objects. It is part of Spark's network buffer management system.

classes.name: ManagedBuffer
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for immutable data buffers with methods for size, data access, reference counting, and conversion to Netty objects.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the data in bytes.

methods.name: nioByteBuffer
methods.description: Returns the data as a ByteBuffer without affecting the buffer's content.

methods.name: createInputStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream view of the data.

methods.name: retain
methods.description: Increments the reference count if applicable.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deallocates if it reaches zero.

methods.name: convertToNetty
methods.description: Converts the buffer to a Netty object for writing out.

methods.name: convertToNettyForSsl
methods.description: Converts the buffer to a Netty object suitable for SSL encryption.
